scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && concurrently -n contracts,backend,webapp -c yellow,cyan,green "bun run --cwd packages/contracts dev" "bun run --cwd backend dev" "bun run --cwd webapp dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd webapp build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd webapp typecheck
